quests.instruction: There are many items on the table. Decide which one stands out most and describe it first.
quests.hint: Say what stands out, then add two or three other items by their positions.
quests.explanation: With a crowded scene the learner must choose what to describe first, which is the difference between a list and a real description.
quests.sceneText: Flea Market Table|stacks of vinyl records|framed prints|vintage radio with a wooden case
quests.sampleAnswer: There's a lot on the table, but the item that stands out is an old radio with a wooden case and round dials. Next to it there are stacks of records and a few framed prints leaning against a box.
options: Vintage radio with a wooden case
acceptedSynonyms: vintage radio,old radio,radio with a wooden case
quests.correctAnswer: Vintage radio with a wooden case

quests.instruction: Pick the section that has vehicles and describe how it is displayed compared with the rest.
quests.hint: Describe the vehicle section first, then the other two sections in order.
quests.explanation: The learner picks one section of a crowded display and links it to the two others by shelf position.
quests.sceneText: Toy Aisle|row of remote-control cars|shelves of dolls|stacks of puzzles
quests.sampleAnswer: The remote-control cars are displayed in a row on the top shelf, each in its own box. Below them there are shelves of dolls, and puzzles are stacked at the bottom.

quests.instruction: Find the item that looks the messiest and describe it and what surrounds it.
quests.hint: Say which item is messy and why, then say what is around it.
quests.explanation: A messy scene needs clear priorities: the learner starts with the most unusual detail and then places the others.
quests.sceneText: Messy Workstation|three monitors in a row|keyboard covered with sticky notes|mug full of pens
quests.sampleAnswer: The keyboard is covered with yellow sticky notes, so it's hard to see the keys. Three monitors stand in a row behind it, and a mug full of pens is on the right.
acceptedSynonyms: keyboard with sticky notes,covered keyboard,messy keyboard
mug of pens,pen mug,cup of pens

quests.instruction: Describe the people and their pets: who is next to whom and what each is doing. Start with the person in the middle.
quests.hint: Go from left to right and say what each person is holding.
quests.explanation: Describing several people by who is next to whom links their actions and positions in one description.
quests.sceneText: Vet Waiting Room|woman holding a cat carrier|man with a large dog on a lead|girl petting a rabbit
quests.sampleAnswer: A woman is holding a cat carrier on her lap, and next to her a man is holding a large dog on a lead. On the other side, a girl is petting a rabbit.
options: Man with a large dog on a lead
acceptedSynonyms: woman with a carrier,woman holding a cat carrier,woman with a cat
man with a dog,man with a large dog,man holding a lead
girl petting a rabbit,girl with a rabbit,girl stroking a rabbit
quests.correctAnswer: Man with a large dog on a lead

quests.instruction: Describe all three people: what each is doing and where each is standing. Finish with the person who is not playing.
quests.hint: Say what the two men are doing at the table, then where the woman is.
quests.explanation: The learner links two people who are doing related things and a third who watches, which is a common pattern in a busy scene.
quests.sceneText: Pool Hall|man chalking his cue|man lining up a shot|woman watching from a stool
quests.sampleAnswer: One man is lining up a shot at the table while another chalks his cue beside him. A woman is watching from a stool near the wall.
acceptedSynonyms: man chalking his cue,man with a cue,man chalking
man lining up a shot,man at the table,man aiming
woman watching,woman on a stool,woman near the wall

quests.instruction: Describe the people behind and in front of the counter, and how their actions connect. Start with the person using a knife.
quests.hint: Say what happens behind the counter first, then who is sitting in front.
quests.explanation: The learner describes two sides of a counter and shows how the actions on each side connect.
quests.sceneText: Sushi Counter|man slicing fish|woman rolling rice in a mat|two customers seated at the counter
quests.sampleAnswer: Behind the counter, a man is slicing fish while a woman next to him is rolling rice in a bamboo mat. In front, two customers are sitting on stools, waiting.
options: Woman rolling rice in a mat
Two customers seated at the counter
acceptedSynonyms: man slicing fish,man with a knife,man cutting fish
woman rolling rice,woman with a bamboo mat,woman making rolls
customers at the counter,two customers,people seated

quests.instruction: Describe how the objects overlap, and end with what is behind the tray.
quests.hint: Use 'sitting on', 'behind', and 'hanging above' to link the objects.
quests.explanation: In a crowded scene, objects overlap, and the learner must use more than one relation ('on' and 'behind') in the same description.
quests.sceneText: Craft Room Shelf|tray of button jars|scissors on a hook|rolls of fabric behind the tray
quests.sampleAnswer: Jars of buttons are sitting on a tray, and behind the tray there are rolls of fabric leaning against the wall. A pair of scissors is hanging from a hook above them.
options: Rolls of fabric behind the tray
acceptedSynonyms: button jars,tray of jars,jars of buttons
scissors,scissors on a hook,pair of scissors
quests.correctAnswer: Rolls of fabric behind the tray

quests.instruction: Explain how the luggage is stacked, starting with what is against the wall.
quests.hint: Start with the stack, then what is on it, then what hangs beside it.
quests.explanation: The learner describes a stack with 'stacked', 'on top of', and 'beside', three relations that often overlap in one scene.
quests.sceneText: Luggage Room|umbrella hanging on a hook|backpack on top of the suitcases|stacked suitcases against the wall
quests.sampleAnswer: Three suitcases are stacked against the wall, with a backpack on top of them. An umbrella is hanging on a hook beside the stack.
options: Backpack on top of the suitcases
acceptedSynonyms: backpack,backpack on the suitcases,bag on top

quests.instruction: Find the item that is partly hidden under another object and describe all three relationships.
quests.hint: Say which item is partly hidden, then what is on top of it, then the third item.
quests.explanation: 'Half under' and 'leaning against' describe overlap between objects, which is common when objects are close together.
quests.sceneText: Hallway Table|bowl of keys on the table|letters half under the bowl|umbrella leaning against the table
quests.sampleAnswer: A bowl of keys is sitting on the table, with some letters half under it. An umbrella is leaning against the side of the table.
options: Bowl of keys on the table
acceptedSynonyms: bowl of keys,keys in a bowl,key bowl

quests.instruction: Describe what is happening in the foreground and what is going on behind.
quests.hint: Start with the foreground action, then the middle, and finish with the background.
quests.explanation: The learner describes multiple actions by layer, with the closest action first.
quests.sceneText: Fish Market|man lifting a crate|two women pointing at the fish|gulls circling in the background
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, a man is lifting a crate of fish onto a table. Behind him, two women are talking and pointing at the fish, and gulls are circling in the background.
acceptedSynonyms: man lifting a crate,man with a crate,man carrying fish
two women pointing,women pointing at fish,women talking

quests.instruction: Describe the action in the foreground and what is going on farther back.
quests.hint: Use 'in the foreground' for the balloon and 'farther back' for the sky.
quests.explanation: Two levels of action (in front and behind) with three different verbs give the learner a way to describe a lively scene.
quests.sceneText: Balloon Field|people holding ropes|balloon being inflated|balloons floating in the sky
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, a large balloon is being inflated on the grass, and several people are holding ropes. Farther back, more balloons are already floating in the sky.
acceptedSynonyms: balloon being inflated,large balloon,balloon on the grass

quests.instruction: Describe the action closest to the bus, then what is happening farther back.
quests.hint: Say what is happening at the door first, then behind the children.
quests.explanation: 'Lining up' and 'waving' are two simultaneous actions in different layers, which is how a crowded morning scene looks.
quests.sceneText: School Bus Stop Morning|children lining up to board|parents waving from the pavement|yellow bus with an open door
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, children are lining up to board the yellow bus. Behind them, a few parents are waving from the pavement, and the bus door is open.
options: Yellow bus with an open door
acceptedSynonyms: children lining up,kids boarding,children at the bus
parents waving,adults waving,parents on the pavement
yellow bus,bus with an open door,school bus

quests.instruction: You want to tell a staff member that something was left behind. What do you mention first, and where is it?
quests.hint: Say the most important detail first, then where it is, then one or two minor details.
quests.explanation: Prioritizing for a purpose means putting the detail that matters to the listener first, even if other things are more eye-catching.
quests.sceneText: Station Bench|man reading a newspaper|blue bag on the bench|clock above the entrance
quests.sampleAnswer: There's a blue bag on the bench by the entrance, and nobody is sitting next to it. A man is reading a newspaper two benches away, and there's a clock above the entrance.
acceptedSynonyms: man reading,man with a newspaper,man on a bench
blue bag,bag on the bench,left bag

quests.instruction: A friend wants to know if there is enough room to work. Which detail do you mention first?
quests.hint: Start with the detail your friend cares about, then add the smaller ones.
quests.explanation: The learner chooses the detail that fits the listener's question, which is a real-world skill when describing a place to someone.
quests.sceneText: Kitchen Tour|gas stove|large window above the sink|wide empty counter
quests.sampleAnswer: There's a wide counter with plenty of empty space to work. The stove is on the left, and a large window above the sink lets in daylight.

quests.instruction: A driver asks if they can park. What should you point out first?
quests.hint: Start with what answers the driver's question, then add the other details.
quests.explanation: The most useful detail is the one that answers the question, so the learner leads with the sign and adds the rest afterward.
quests.sceneText: Parking Lot Entrance|sign saying Full|ticket machine on the right|barrier pulled down
quests.sampleAnswer: The most important thing is the sign at the entrance that says 'Full'. The barrier is down, and the ticket machine is on the right.
acceptedSynonyms: full sign,sign saying full,parking full sign
ticket machine,machine on the right,ticket dispenser

quests.instruction: Find the animal there is only one of, and compare the numbers of the others.
quests.hint: Give a number for each animal, using 'dozens of', 'three', and 'only one'.
quests.explanation: 'Dozens of', 'three', and 'only one' give three levels of quantity, so the learner can compare groups in one description.
quests.sceneText: Public Aquarium Tank|dozens of small fish|three large fish|one stingray
quests.sampleAnswer: There's only one stingray, lying near the bottom. Three large fish are swimming near it, and dozens of small fish are moving in a group near the top.
acceptedSynonyms: small fish,dozens of fish,school of fish

quests.instruction: Compare quantities: which vegetable is there only a couple of?
quests.hint: Give an amount for each vegetable, from the most to the fewest.
quests.explanation: The learner uses 'lots of', 'a couple of', and 'just one' to rank amounts, which is more natural than exact numbers.
quests.sceneText: Vegetable Box|bunch of carrots|two red peppers|one large cabbage
quests.sampleAnswer: There are lots of carrots in a bunch, two red peppers, and just one large cabbage.

quests.instruction: Describe how many boats are empty and how many have people in them.
quests.hint: Say the total first, then how many are in each state.
quests.explanation: The learner combines a total ('five'), a part ('two'), and a single ('one') in a short quantity description.
quests.sceneText: Boat Rental Dock|five rowing boats tied up|two empty boats floating|one boat with two people
quests.sampleAnswer: There are five rowing boats tied up at the dock. Two empty boats are floating nearby, and one boat has two people in it.
acceptedSynonyms: boat with two people,occupied boat,one boat

quests.instruction: Describe three layers: the closest, the middle, and the farthest. Start with the closest layer.
quests.hint: Use 'in the foreground', 'in the middle distance', and 'far above'.
quests.explanation: Three layers (near, middle, far) give the learner a clear framework for organizing a large, busy scene.
quests.sceneText: Football Match|players near the camera|crowd in the stands|floodlights above the stadium
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, two players are running for the ball. In the middle distance, the stands are packed with people, and far above them floodlights stand on tall poles.

quests.instruction: Describe three layers, ending with what is farthest away.
quests.hint: Go from the front layer to the back, and use a different action for each.
quests.explanation: The learner describes three layers in order, ending on the object that is farthest and highest.
quests.sceneText: Village Fair|children on pony rides|stalls with striped roofs|windmill on the hill
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, children are riding ponies around a ring. In the middle, stalls with striped roofs line a path, and on the hill in the background a windmill stands against the sky.
acceptedSynonyms: children on ponies,pony rides,children riding ponies

quests.instruction: Describe three layers: the person closest, the water, and the hills.
quests.hint: Start with the person, then the water, then the hills in the distance.
quests.explanation: This task uses one person, one middle layer, and one background layer, so each layer has a clear job.
quests.sceneText: Bird Watching Hide|man holding binoculars|ducks on the water|hills in the distance
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, a man is holding binoculars to his eyes. In the middle, ducks are swimming on the water, and in the distance there are low hills.

quests.instruction: Describe the studio by stations, starting with the equipment at the table.
quests.hint: Use one sentence per station and use 'on the left' and 'at the table'.
quests.explanation: Describing a space as a series of stations helps the learner cover several objects without repeating the same structure.
quests.sceneText: Radio Studio|two microphones on arms|mixing desk with sliders|glass window to the next room
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a small radio studio. Two microphones on long arms are positioned at the table, a mixing desk with rows of sliders is on the left, and a glass window separates the studio from the next room.
options: Glass window to the next room
acceptedSynonyms: glass window,window to the next room,studio window

quests.instruction: Describe the studio by stations and end with the drying shelf.
quests.hint: Move through the stations in order and finish at the last one.
quests.explanation: The learner lists three stations in order and uses 'between' and 'against the wall' to link them.
quests.sceneText: Painting Studio|tables with white mugs|jars of paint|drying shelf with painted plates
quests.sampleAnswer: There are two tables with white mugs, jars of paint are lined up between them, and a drying shelf with painted plates stands against the wall.

quests.instruction: Describe the setup by stations, starting with the lights.
quests.hint: Start with the lights, then the camera, then the backdrop.
quests.explanation: The learner follows a natural setup order (lights, camera, backdrop), which is how someone would explain how a studio works.
quests.sceneText: Photo Studio|camera on a tripod|two umbrella lights|gray paper backdrop
quests.sampleAnswer: Two umbrella lights stand on either side of the set, a camera is mounted on a tripod in front, and a gray paper backdrop hangs behind.

quests.instruction: Describe the parade from front to back and end with the people who follow.
quests.hint: Use 'at the front', 'behind them', and 'following' in order.
quests.explanation: A parade is a moving line, so the learner uses sequence words ('at the front', 'behind them', 'follow') to describe order.
quests.sceneText: Street Parade|marching drummers|float decorated with flowers|dancers in feathered costumes
quests.sampleAnswer: At the front, drummers in matching jackets are marching. Behind them, a float decorated with flowers is moving slowly, and dancers in feathered costumes follow with their arms raised.

quests.instruction: Describe the crowd first, then the screen and the equipment behind them.
quests.hint: Start with the people, then the screen, then the projector at the back.
quests.explanation: The learner starts with a large group and then describes the objects the group is looking at.
quests.sceneText: Outdoor Movie Night|people on blankets|large white screen|projector on a table
quests.sampleAnswer: Dozens of people are sitting on blankets on the grass, facing a large white screen at the front. A projector sits on a table at the back, and some people are carrying snacks.
acceptedSynonyms: projector,projector on a table,table with a projector

quests.instruction: Start with the person who is tasting, then describe who is cooking and who is watching.
quests.hint: Use 'in the front row', 'at the first table', and 'from behind a rope'.
quests.explanation: The learner describes three groups by what they do (cook, taste, watch) and where they are.
quests.sceneText: Cooking Contest|contestants at portable stoves|man tasting a dish|spectators behind the rope
quests.sampleAnswer: In the front row, several contestants are cooking at portable stoves. A man in a dark jacket is tasting a dish at the first table, and a crowd is watching from behind a rope.
acceptedSynonyms: man tasting a dish,man tasting,man with a spoon

quests.instruction: Describe this scene in six sentences: overview, the largest features, the people, and the end of the street. Focus on the people in the middle of the street.
quests.hint: Give each sentence one job, and finish with the end of the street.
quests.explanation: Level 110 asks for a dense scene described in six organized sentences, with the most important features first.
quests.sceneText: Main Street Market Day|striped awnings over the stalls|crowd of shoppers in the middle|delivery van at the far end
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a main street on market day. Striped awnings cover the stalls on both sides, and a crowd of shoppers fills the middle of the street. A woman on the left is picking out vegetables, while a man on the right is holding up a jacket. Children are running between the stalls. At the far end, a delivery van is parked. Above the street, small flags are strung from building to building.
options: Crowd of shoppers in the middle
Delivery van at the far end
acceptedSynonyms: striped awnings,awnings over the stalls,stall awnings
crowd of shoppers,shoppers,crowd in the middle
delivery van,parked van,van at the end
quests.correctAnswer: Crowd of shoppers in the middle

quests.instruction: Describe the glasshouse in six or seven sentences, moving from the largest features to the smallest.
quests.hint: Start with the overall space, then the biggest plants, then the people, then smaller details.
quests.explanation: The learner moves from the biggest features to the smallest ones in a dense scene, which makes a long description easy to follow.
quests.sceneText: Tropical Glasshouse|tall palm trees|visitors walking on the path|small pond with lilies
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a tropical glasshouse with a high glass roof. Tall palm trees fill the center, and their leaves reach almost to the roof. A curved path winds between them, and several visitors are walking along it, some taking photos. On the right, there's a small pond with lilies, and a wooden bridge crosses it. Near the entrance, a family is looking at a map. Everything is surrounded by green plants in large pots.

quests.instruction: Describe the square in six or seven sentences and finish with the performer.
quests.hint: Start with the whole square, then the fountain, then the people, and end with the performer.
quests.explanation: The learner saves the most active detail (the performer) for last, so the description builds toward it.
quests.sceneText: City Square at Night|illuminated fountain|people taking photos|street performer juggling
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a city square at night, with lamps around the edges. In the center, an illuminated fountain sends water into the air, and people are standing around it taking photos. Cafes with outdoor tables line one side, and their windows are lit. A few couples are walking slowly across the stones. In front of the fountain, a street performer is juggling three balls, and a small crowd is watching.
